name: delete_plugin
description: Permanently uninstalls a plugin that's already installed (see list_installed_plugins), freeing its slot entirely -- a real, permanent change on the hub, performed through this assistant. Code-enforced two-call confirm: call once without `confirmed` (or `confirmed: false`) to resolve the plugin and see what would be deleted -- this does not delete anything. Only call again with `confirmed: true` after the customer/developer has explicitly agreed to delete it -- never speculatively. This tool re-verifies plugin_id/name against the real installed list itself and returns an error if it isn't actually installed, but still pass the exact plugin_id/name from list_installed_plugins rather than guessing -- don't rely on this check in place of that.

plugin_id.description: The plugin's `plugin_id`, exactly as returned by list_installed_plugins -- never guessed.

name.description: The plugin's exact display `name`, from list_installed_plugins -- used to build the confirmation/result text without a separate lookup.

confirmed.description: Leave unset (or false) for the first call, which only previews the delete and performs no side effects. Set to true only on a follow-up call, only after the customer/developer has explicitly agreed to delete it.
